verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning SaaS with an SDK, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The Events, monitoring and webhook docs cover customer-submitted fraud data, not product telemetry, so they are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
